_comment: Where the pre-rework mastery data files (season*-data.js, data.js, keystone data) disagreed with Data Dragon / the wiki, and which side the per-patch datasets follow. Imported by tools/import-masteries.js from the research discrepancy lists; documentation only (the build does not read it).

ddragonEra.note: repo keeps the V3.14 launch value

ddragonEra.wiki: mastery page 15% trinkets; V3.14 patch page 10% wards+trinkets = pre-release text

ddragonEra.winner: wiki for duration, DDragon/wiki for damage type

ddragonEra.wiki: WP V5.10 25/50/75; WM effect line 25, WM history line 20; Riot 5.10 notes 25/50/75

ddragonEra.ours: desc: melee 10 gold on hit (rankDesc already DDragon '+8')

ddragonEra.where: season4-data.js header, data.js s4-final, research notes

ddragonEra.winner: DDragon/wiki (same class of bug as the Sunder/Hardiness/Resistance fix)

ddragonEra.ours: 5 (+50% bAD +20% AP) over 3 s; AoE/DoT 2.5 over 1.5 s
ddragonEra.ddragon: 6 over 3 s; AoE/DoT half (3) over 1.5 s
ddragonEra.wiki: WP/WM V5.22 entry 5; WM/WP V5.24 entry 'from 6' and AoE 'from 3'; Riot 5.22 notes give ratios only
V5.23: tooltip corrected, real threshold was 25%
ddragonEra.winner: keep 20% if the page shows the V5.22 client tooltip; 25% is the real mechanic

ddragonEra.wiki: WP, WM, Riot 6.22 notes: 1% -> 1.5% (max 7.5%); V7.4 back to 1%

ddragonEra.ours: 4% DR, 8% near an ally, 8% redirect, stops below 15% HP (the V5.22 launch text)
ddragonEra.ddragon: 4% DR, 6% redirect from the nearest ally, not below 5% HP
ddragonEra.wiki: V5.23 2%, V5.24 3%/6%/6%/5%, V6.1 4% and near-ally bonus removed

ddragonEra.ours: basic attacks and abilities grant stacks
ddragonEra.wiki: WM V6.22: undocumented, no longer stacks on ability damage
WM 6 s; WP and Riot 6.22 notes 9 s

ddragonEra.ddragon: 3.14.12-3.14.19 pre-release data; 3.14.x 'Runic Shield', 'Veteran Scars'; 'Perseverance ' trailing space (2014); 5.22.1 pre-release Vampirism/Legendary Guardian; 'game_mastery_displayname_6112' for Sorcery 5.22.1-5.24.1; Bond of Stone threshold missing 5.24.2-6.2.1; no ranges in Legendary Guardian / Scavenger text
ddragonEra.winner: use the last build per patch, alias the names, take ranges from the wiki
for a V3.14 entry show the swapped names (that is what the client showed) or the fixed ones with a note

ddragonEra.wiki: 2 ranks (5/10, 10/20 from V5.10); Utility total 33 needs 2

wikiEra.issue: season1-data.js keeps Demolisher (Offense tier 4) but it was removed with Promote in V1.0.0.63 (2009-12-17) and never returned
evidence: Riot 2010 client screenshot: Offense tier 4 = Brute Force only
wikiEra.impact: every S1 patch from V1.0.0.63 on, including the current late-S1 label; share-code slot = Offense array position 11

wikiEra.issue: patchLabel 'V1.0.0.130 (Late Season 1)' is a Season 2 patch (2011-11-29, after the V1.0.0.129 rework of 2011-11-15). Last S1-masteries patch is V1.0.0.128 (2011-11-01)

s3-pbe is dpatti's 11/28 PBE data (commit 46150fc), labelled V1.0.0.152 live. Live 152: Legendary Armor 2/3.5/5 (ours 2/4/6), Scout 5 s (ours 3 s), Bladed Armor true damage vs minions and monsters (ours: monsters only)

fandom, wiki.leagueoflegends.com and Leaguepedia S2 tabs give Hardiness 2/3.5/5, Executioner 5% below 50%, Summoner's Insight Teleport 0.5 s and the S3 Summoner's Resolve lines (Barrier +20 shield, Heal +5 hp/level). Riot's own 2011-11-14 Season Two page (and dpatti, and our s2-ahri) give 2/4/6, 6% below 40%, 1 s, Revive/Cleanse/Heal/Smite/Garrison. The wiki S2 tabs look copied from S3; kept Riot values
per-mastery page: 10-180 bonus heal since June 2009 -> 30 s CDR in V1.0.0.61. Heal page + V1.0.0.52 note: +75 heal and -10 s CD until V1.0.0.52, then 10 x level. Used the Heal page / patch notes

mastery page says 'increased to 0.33/0.66/1% from 0.1/0.2/0.3%', overview says 'reduced by about 33%'. Consistent once units are read as per-second (old) vs per-5-seconds (new): 0.5/1/1.5 -> 0.33/0.66/1 per 5 s
2011 page history says 'with 4 ranks', header and dataset say 3; 3 confirmed by the 2010 client screenshot (1/3)
fandom's patch lists end ranked Season One at V1.0.0.125 and start 'Season Two' at V1.0.0.126; the mastery system changed only at V1.0.0.129, so S1 masteries run to V1.0.0.128
